description.zh-CN: Nous Research 出品的开源个人 Agent：一条命令装好，终端里聊天、连 Telegram/Discord 等消息渠道、装技能、跑定时任务；自带 Python/Node 工具链，装在你自己的用户目录，不用管理员权限。
description.en: Open-source personal agent from Nous Research — one-command install, chat in the terminal or wire it to Telegram/Discord and other channels, skills and scheduled tasks; bundles its own Python/Node toolchain into your user directory, no admin rights.

node.recommended: not required (the installer bootstraps its own toolchain)
node.supported: not required (the installer bootstraps its own toolchain)

runtime.note: The official installers provision Python 3.14, Node.js, npm, pnpm, ripgrep and FFmpeg into the Hermes home (~/.hermes on Linux/macOS/WSL2, %LOCALAPPDATA%\hermes on native Windows) — no admin rights needed. Windows note: antivirus may flag the bundled uv.exe (Astral's uv) as a false positive; whitelist the bin folder if that happens (upstream documents it).

packages.name: Hermes official Windows installer (install.ps1)
packages.hashSource: Official endpoint https://hermes-agent.nousresearch.com/install.ps1 full download sha256 measured locally (2026-11-12)

channels.note: The exact script the official PowerShell one-liner downloads (iex (irm …)). Daily probe re-downloads and re-hashes (package < 5 MB) — a hash drift means upstream changed the installer script and this profile must be re-verified.

install.notes: Runs the hash-verified official installer exactly like `iex (irm https://hermes-agent.nousresearch.com/install.ps1)` (stdin/iex semantics preserved), landing in %LOCALAPPDATA%\hermes with bundled Python/Node toolchain — zero admin. Interactive prompts may appear (setup wizard offers `hermes setup --portal` afterwards). TODO real-machine verification.

packages.name: Hermes official Unix installer (install.sh)
packages.hashSource: Official endpoint https://hermes-agent.nousresearch.com/install.sh full download sha256 measured locally (2026-11-12)

channels.note: The exact script the official `curl -fsSL … | bash` one-liner downloads. Daily probe re-downloads and re-hashes (package < 5 MB); a hash drift = upstream edited the installer → re-verify and bump.

install.notes: Feeds the hash-verified official installer into bash exactly like `curl -fsSL https://hermes-agent.nousresearch.com/install.sh | bash`; installs into ~/.hermes (bundled toolchain, no admin). Interactive prompts possible. TODO real-machine verification.

direct-install.label: Official installer script (single route, both platforms)
direct-install.note: Hermes publishes no GitHub release assets (releases/latest v0.23.1 has 0 assets, measured 2026-11-12) — distribution is the official installer script, so there is no GitHub URL for the gateway list to accelerate. CN region uses the same direct route to hermes-agent.nousresearch.com (CN reachability TODO field measurement).

netConfig.registrySourcesNote: registry JSON multi-source cross-check (any two must agree); hash acquisition only through these sources plus GitHub release metadata (S2/S4).

proxyGateways.note: Repo-wide gateway list (S3); probed daily against a GitHub release-asset URL. This app's channels are non-GitHub and do not route through it.

openrouter.label: OpenRouter (one key for every model)
openrouter.notes: Hermes allows OpenRouter as an allowlisted secret (README migration notes); set keys via `hermes model` / `hermes config set` — values persist to HERMES_HOME/config.yaml (~/.hermes/config.yaml on Unix, %LOCALAPPDATA%\hermes\config.yaml on native Windows). Model list/price TODO re-check before CONFIG screens.

openai.label: OpenAI
openai.notes: OpenAI is an allowlisted Hermes secret (README); pick the model with `hermes model openai:<model>`.

anthropic.label: Anthropic (Claude)

recommendedModels.name: Claude Sonnet 4
recommendedModels.note: Hermes default family, strong at agentic work

anthropic.notes: Anthropic is an allowlisted Hermes secret (README).

nous-portal.label: Nous Portal (one subscription: models + tools, OAuth)
nous-portal.notes: `hermes setup --portal` logs in via OAuth, sets Nous as provider and enables the Tool Gateway (web search, image gen, TTS, cloud browser) — no separate keys to collect (README). Inspect anytime with `hermes portal info`.

upgrade.notes: Check = local probe vs the upstream latest tag the daily probe records; upgrade = run `hermes update` (self-update command) or re-run the AiBOX install (official installer is idempotent).

steps: Run the official `hermes uninstall` command (subcommand ships with the CLI)
If anything remains, delete the Hermes home: ~/.hermes (Unix/macOS/WSL2) or %LOCALAPPDATA%\hermes (native Windows)
Remove the Hermes entry from your shell PATH/rc files if the installer added one
uninstall.notes: Config, sessions, skills and cached toolchain all live under the Hermes home directory; removing it completes the uninstall.

risk.onUninstall: 配置文件里的 API key、聊天会话记录、已安装技能都会随 ~/.hermes 一起删除——请先备份 config.yaml 和 sessions / Your API keys in config.yaml, chat sessions and installed skills are deleted together with ~/.hermes — back up config.yaml and sessions first.
